findings.fact: Initial high-Z goal connectors have local=false; instead an ascent entry is searched for 1589ms CPU / 21453ms wall and published as an incomplete action-chain preview. The request then times out at 30 seconds.
Several stair/turn audits reject surface normals around 0.35-0.38. Their exact physical surroundings were not captured, so footprint-contact cause remains unconfirmed in the game.
Action connector expanded 709 nodes and made 7242 step probes, including 1429 hint probes / 1237 accepted. A finite candidate-only control isolates offset-grid duplication, not game collision.
